phases.name: Launch
phases.description: The launch vehicle begins the mission and carries the spacecraft toward its planned trajectory.

phases.name: Separation
phases.description: The spacecraft separates from the launch vehicle and begins operating independently.

phases.name: Transfer
phases.description: The spacecraft performs its transfer toward the target mission orbit.

phases.name: Orbit Insertion
phases.description: The spacecraft performs the maneuver required to enter the planned orbit.

phases.name: Science
phases.description: The spacecraft operates its instruments and collects science data.
